lines.text: A wise servant will rule over a disgraceful son and share his inheritance with the brothers.
The LORD is the tester of hearts, and whoever mocks the poor insults their Maker.
It is better to meet a lion robbed of her cubs than a fool in his folly.
To start a quarrel is to release a fire, so abandon the dispute before it breaks out.
A man of knowledge restrains his words, and even a fool is considered wise if he keeps silent.
